races.display_title: Qatar Racing British Champions Day Two-Year-Old Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Despite meeting with defeat for the first time, ARAPAHO GOLD arguably enhanced his reputation trying to concede weight all round in the Mill Reef at Newbury and he looks a very solid proposition in this good-quality opening race. Inner City Blues remains a top prospect despite a slightly underwhelming effort in the Middle Park, while Night In Vegas has already had a lucrative season and can make his presence felt again. ARAPAHO GOLD (IRE) INNER CITY BLUES (IRE) NIGHT IN VEGAS (IRE)

races.display_title: Qatar Racing British Champions Long Distance Cup (Group 1)
races.verdict: Joseph O'Brien's upwardly-mobile stayer HIGHWAYMAN can add to his St Leger triumph and extend his winning sequence to 4 with this first go over 2m bound to suit. Caballo de Mar is a big threat on the back of his game Prix du Cadran success from the absent Scandinavia, although the rejuvenated Gregory is also well in the mix and Ebor 1-3 Daiquiri Bay and Opportunity rate lively outsiders too in this fascinating clash. HIGHWAYMAN (FR) CABALLO DE MAR (IRE) GREGORY

races.display_title: Qatar Racing British Champions Sprint Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict: ALMERAQ is perhaps at his best on a softer surface but his win in the Jubilee at the Royal Meeting here proved he's still a top-class sprinter under quicker conditions and he'll be the one to beat again as he bids for a third top-level success of the campaign. Division wasn't seen to maximum effect in the Bengough but still appeals as one who should prove well suited by this stiff 6f and he can get back on track, with Paborus also likely to make the podium behind Almeraq again. ALMERAQ DIVISION PABORUS

races.display_title: Qatar Racing British Champions Fillies & Mares Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict: Remarkable mare KALPANA has had some tough battles this year but may have enough left in the tank to secure a third successive victory in this race. Minnie Hauk 's standout effort this season came when runner-up in the Prince of Wales's Stakes here, and she's feared most if recapturing that sort of form. Sparan Nua was narrowly touched off by Kalpana at York and could be worth another chance to confirm that improvement, while impressive Irish Oaks winner Johanna Walsh isn't taken lightly. KALPANA MINNIE HAUK (IRE) SPARAN NUA (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Kalpana (1/1), Minnie Hauk (5/1), Lilt (6/1), Johanna Walsh (13/2), Sparan Nua (17/2), Believed (16/1), Danielle (22/1), See The Fire (28/1), Inis Mor (28/1), Coedana (33/1), Symbol Of Majesty (40/1), Tajlina (40/1), Sugar Island (150/1)

races.verdict: HAVANOTHERGUINNESS ticks plenty of boxes on paper so he's a straightforward choice to make a winning start. Duhallow Storm failed to live up to market expectations on his debut over C&D back in the spring but could be more of a late developer like his dam, so it's reasonable to believe he should prove capable of better. races.display_title: Pertemps Network Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: IVOR BEAR failed to win a bumper last season but showed plenty on all 3 outings and there's a strong feeling that jumping could well be the making of him given his physique. He's narrowly preferred to Hold The Throw , who came from a less-than-ideal position to land a steadily-run bumper at Perth in May. Sir Edward Lear showed only a little promise on his hurdling debut at Huntingdon last November but should be capable of better. IVOR BEAR (IRE) HOLD THE THROW (IRE) SIR EDWARD LEAR

races.verdict: LEXINGTON BLITZ is likely in much better heart than recent form figures might suggest and he's taken to follow up his success in this corresponding event 12 months ago. Baker Blue looks interesting back in a handicap from a handy draw and could be the main threat. Spartan Arrow also appeals off a much-reduced mark, in what looks a wide-open renewal. LEXINGTON BLITZ (IRE) BAKER BLUE SPARTAN ARROW (IRE)

races.verdict: GENTLE WARRIOR has been running in much better company of late and while not the most straightforward, he could be worth a chance dropped into this sort of grade.
